butterbot.msg.picked_up: %s was packed up. Its name, skin and program are kept in the item.
butterbot.msg.lava_ahead: Lava ahead! I can't plug it here.
butterbot.msg.no_base: I have no Bot Base. Place one near me or press 'Link this base'.
butterbot.msg.base_gone: My base is gone! Someone broke it.
butterbot.msg.cant_reach_base: I can't reach the base from here.
butterbot.msg.base_missing_fallback: I can't find my base, bringing it to you instead.
butterbot.msg.waiting_for_owner: Waiting for my owner to come back...
butterbot.msg.cant_find_more: I can't find more %s. Bringing back what I have.
butterbot.msg.found_nothing: I searched far and wide but found no %s. Giving up.
butterbot.msg.tunnel_unreachable: I can't reach the tunnel start at %s.
butterbot.msg.tunnel_lava: Lava at %s that I couldn't plug. Stopped for safety after %s/%s blocks.
butterbot.msg.tunnel_stuck: I'm stuck in the tunnel. Dug %s/%s blocks.
butterbot.msg.tunnel_too_long: That tunnel is too long (max %s blocks).
butterbot.msg.no_recipe: I don't know a crafting recipe for %s.
butterbot.msg.backpack_limits_craft: My backpack only fits ingredients for %sx %s.
butterbot.msg.container_unreachable: I can't reach the container at %s.
butterbot.msg.bot_out_of_reach: That bot is out of reach. Stand at a Bot Base or get closer.
butterbot.msg.too_far_backpack: Get closer to the bot to open its backpack.
butterbot.msg.no_bot_nearby: You have no bot within %s blocks. Type /butterbot summon to call one.
butterbot.msg.skin_missing: The server doesn't have that skin yet. Try Apply again.
butterbot.skin.error.not_png: That file is not a PNG image.
butterbot.skin.error.bad_size: Use a normal Minecraft player skin: 64x64, 64x32 or HD (128 to 1024, square).
butterbot.skin.error.corrupt: The skin file changed or is damaged. Press Refresh.
butterbot.skin.error.io: Could not save the skin file.
butterbot.skin.error.slow_down: Uploading too fast, wait a moment.
butterbot.tooltip.place_hint: Use on a block to place. It will belong to you.
butterbot.gui.no_bots: No bots found. Type /butterbot summon in chat to call one (up to 5). Bots within 200 blocks of you or of a Bot Base are listed here.
butterbot.gui.release_tooltip: Release this bot (it stops being yours)
butterbot.gui.delivery_tooltip: Where loot goes when a job is done or the backpack is full.
butterbot.gui.link_base_tooltip: Make the Bot Base you opened this panel from the bot's home
butterbot.gui.craft_hint: The bot looks in chests, barrels and Bot Base storage within 64 blocks, takes exactly what the recipe needs, crafts and delivers. Press Tab to accept a suggestion.
butterbot.gui.tunnel_hint: Dug at the bot's current height.
butterbot.gui.api_help_text:
bot.say(text)  bot.pos() -> x,y,z
bot.goTo(x,y,z) -> ok  bot.dig(x,y,z) -> ok
bot.place(x,y,z,"item") -> ok  bot.block(x,y,z) -> id
bot.scan("name", radius) -> x,y,z
bot.deliver()  bot.deposit()  bot.home()
bot.count("item")  bot.inventoryCount()
bot.ownerPos() -> x,y,z
bot.sleep(seconds)  print(...)
butterbot.gui.pick_skin: Pick a skin from the list first.
butterbot.gui.no_skins: No skins yet. Press 'Open folder' and copy Minecraft skin PNGs there, or drag them onto this window.
butterbot.gui.drop_hint: Tip: drag Minecraft skin PNGs onto this window.
butterbot.msg.too_many_bots: You already have %s bots. Send one home first with /butterbot dismiss.
butterbot.msg.summon_failed: Could not summon a bot here.
butterbot.msg.summoned: %s is here (%s/%s bots). Right-click it or type /butterbot menu.
butterbot.msg.dismissed: %s went home. Its backpack was given to you.
butterbot.msg.base_given: Here is a Bot Base. Place it near your bots so they can store loot in it.
butterbot.gui.neko_tooltip: Cat ears, a swaying tail (coloured like the skin's hair) and the neko girl voice. Off: the classic Butter Bot sounds.
butterbot.msg.start_farming: Off to the fields! Harvesting and replanting within %s blocks.
butterbot.msg.no_chests: I found no chests or barrels within %s blocks.
butterbot.msg.guard_on: Guard mode on. I'll keep the monsters away!
butterbot.msg.torches_on: I'll light up dark caves while mining.
butterbot.msg.feed_on: I'll feed you when you're hungry.
butterbot.msg.find_none: No %s within %s blocks of you (only the area around you that is loaded is searched).
butterbot.msg.find_result: Nearest %s: %s (%s blocks away, %s). %s of them together there.
butterbot.msg.level_info: %s: level %s (%s). Digs %s%% faster, %s backpack slots, %s health, Fortune %s, vein %s blocks, %s XP saved for you.
butterbot.levelup.perk.2: Digs faster and has more health.
butterbot.levelup.perk.3: Now mines whole ore veins (up to 8 blocks)!
butterbot.levelup.perk.9: Netherite tools and ore veins up to 64 blocks!
butterbot.gui.find_tooltip: Tells you where the nearest block of this resource is, up to %s blocks from you in the loaded area (also through walls).
butterbot.gui.farm_help: Harvests and replants ripe crops, berries, cocoa, sugar cane, melons and pumpkins, fells grown trees and plants their saplings, and sows seeds on empty farmland. Works within %s blocks of the Bot Base (or of the bot) until you say stop.
butterbot.gui.sort_help: Stacks and groups everything in the chests and barrels within %s blocks of the Bot Base by kind. The base storage is emptied into them too.
butterbot.gui.guard_tooltip: Fights monsters near the bot or you. Never hits players, animals or pets, and leaves endermen and piglins alone until they attack.
butterbot.gui.torches_auto_tooltip: Places a torch whenever it gets dark underground while mining.
butterbot.gui.feed_tooltip: Feeds you food from its backpack when you are hungry (never rotten flesh, golden apples or stews).
butterbot.gui.smelt_tooltip: Built-in furnace, burns coal from its backpack. Ores & food: raw metal to ingots, raw food cooked. Everything: also sand to glass, logs to charcoal, cobblestone to stone...
butterbot.gui.perk_vein: Mines whole ore veins (up to %s blocks)
butterbot.gui.level_hint: Bots level up by working and fighting.
butterbot.msg.unstuck: I got stuck, so I took a shortcut!
butterbot.msg.refill_off: I won't refill your hotbar anymore.
butterbot.msg.start_lighting: Lighting up everything within %s blocks so no monsters spawn!
butterbot.msg.light_done: Done! I placed %s torches. No more dark spots within %s blocks.
butterbot.msg.light_already: Everything within %s blocks is already lit. No monsters can spawn here.
butterbot.msg.light_skipped: I couldn't reach %s dark spots (closed caves or roofs). Light those yourself.
butterbot.msg.fetch_none: I found no %s in my backpack, the Bot Base or the chests within %s blocks.
butterbot.msg.fetch_kept: You weren't around, so I kept the %s in my backpack.
butterbot.msg.fetch_partial: I could only find %s of the %s %s you asked for. Here they are.
butterbot.msg.recover_start: Hang on, I'm saving your things!
butterbot.msg.recover_nothing: I found nothing left at the spot where you died (lava or the void may have taken it).
butterbot.msg.recover_safe: Your things are safe with me: %s items. I'll bring them to you.
butterbot.msg.recover_returned: Here are your things back: %s items. Your armor is back on.
butterbot.msg.death_no_bot: You died at %s. None of your bots was close enough to save your things.
butterbot.msg.death_recovering: You died at %2$s. %1$s is running there to save your things before they disappear!
butterbot.msg.death_unknown: You haven't died yet in this world.
butterbot.msg.death_info: You last died at %s (%s blocks from here).
butterbot.msg.death_info_other: You last died at %s, in another dimension.
butterbot.msg.hotkey_home: %s bots are going home to the Bot Base.
butterbot.msg.hotkey_deliver: %s bots are bringing you their loot.
butterbot.msg.hold_item: Hold the item you want in your hand, then press the key again.
butterbot.msg.where_none: No %s in your bots' backpacks or in the chests within %s blocks of you or the Bot Base.
butterbot.msg.where_header: %s: %s in total. The chests are sparkling now.
butterbot.gui.light_tooltip: Places torches on every dark spot within %s blocks of you so no monsters spawn there. Uses torches from the backpack first.
butterbot.gui.refill_tooltip: When blocks, torches, food, arrows, rockets or pearls in your hotbar run low, the bot tops them up from your inventory, its backpack or the Bot Base (bot within 8 blocks of you).
butterbot.gui.skin_same_as_default: Applied! This skin is the same as the built-in neko skin, so the bot looks the same.
key.butterbot.light: Light up the area around me
key.butterbot.fetch: Fetch more of the item I'm holding
butterbot.gui.default_skin_tooltip: Switches to the next of the %s built-in neko skins (a custom skin is taken off). New bots automatically get a skin none of your other bots wear.
